notes: Berry mobile sends task, message, attachment, approval and session data only to the Berry server the person paired it with by scanning a QR code from their signed-in web session. The app developer receives none of it.
Accounts are created and deleted by the person's organization on its Berry server; the app has no account creation. Signing out or revoking a phone deletes that phone's session on the server.
Camera, photos and files are used only for scanning the sign-in code and for attachments the person chooses. Push notifications are not used in this version.
The app does not sell data, serve ads, or track users across apps or websites.
